# signed-image-proxy

> Image proxy that resizes and crops on demand from HMAC-signed URLs, with an ETag-aware bounded cache and SSRF protection on every fetch Go module `github.com/Trysac/u923-signed-image-proxy`, package `signedimageproxy`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
